description: Measures Metal-units-per-tick a Forge processes as a function of companion layer and forge tier. Each 60-second tick, one Crafter companion assigned to a constructed Forge smelts `ForgeThroughput(layer, tier)` units of Metal. Units are rolled into specific ores (Iron/Copper/Tin/Silver/Mithril) via `RollForgeOre`. One tick = 60s, so tick-rate × 60 = per-hour rate.
designIntent: A mid-game Layer-3 companion at a basic tier-1 Forge produces 1 Metal/tick = 60/hour — enough to convert the ambient drip of salvage Metal without hoarding. Late-game (layer 6, tier 3) achieves 5/tick = 300/hour, matching or exceeding realistic salvage supply. Throughput is deliberately linear-ish rather than exponential so that the Forge is an automation quality-of-life improvement, not a resource printer.
